Abstract.AbstractText: Uniform sized Co9 S8 /MoS2 yolk-shell spheres with an average diameter of about 500 nm have been synthesized by a facile route. When evaluated as anodes for lithium-ion and sodium-ion batteries, these Co9 S8 /MoS2 yolk-shell spheres show high specific capacities, excellent rate capabilities, and good cycling stability.
